meta.tagline: Fresh produce direct from Maldivian farmers
meta.description: Buy fresh vegetables, fruit and more directly from farmers across the atolls of the Maldives.

sample.title: Preview with sample data

home.heroTitle: Fresh from Maldivian farms, straight to you
home.heroBody: Find local produce from farmers across the atolls and contact them directly to arrange delivery.
home.heroImageAlt: Rows of vegetable plants growing on a farm
home.islandsBody: Find produce grown near you, or farms that deliver to your island.
home.registerBody: List your produce for free, reach buyers across the Maldives and keep your invoices in one place.
home.how1Body: Search by product, atoll or island.
home.how2Body: Call or message the farmer directly.
home.how3Body: Agree delivery and payment with the farmer. There are no online payments.

products.emptyBody: Farmers are setting up. Check back soon.
products.noResultsBody: Try fewer filters or a different word.
products.contactBody: Arrange quantity, delivery and payment directly with the farmer.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your farm at a glance. Figures come from your own records.
dashboard.inactiveHint: Drafts, paused, sold out or removed
dashboard.viewsHint: Product page visits, counted once per visitor session
dashboard.contactHint: Taps on Call, WhatsApp or Viber (repeat taps within 30 minutes count once). A tap opens the buyer’s phone or chat app — it doesn’t mean a message was delivered or a sale was made.
dashboard.statusApproved: Your farm is approved and visible on the marketplace.
dashboard.loadFailed: Some figures couldn't be loaded. Please refresh the page.

products.title: Products
products.intro: Add, edit and publish your produce.
products.emptyBody: Add your first product so buyers can find it.
products.confirmDelete: Delete this product? This can't be undone.
products.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
products.notPublicHint: Published products appear on the marketplace once your farm is approved.

form.nameHint: Enter the name in English, Dhivehi or both.
form.availableFromHint: Leave empty if it's available now.
form.pickup: Buyers can collect this product from the farm
form.deliveryHint: Choose where you deliver this product. Manage the list on the Delivery page.
form.noDeliveryAreas: You haven't added any delivery areas yet.
form.imagesHint: Up to 6 photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each). The first photo is the cover.
form.imageWrongType: {name} isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
form.tooManyImages: You can add up to 6 photos.
form.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: This is how buyers will see your product.
preview.notPublic: Buyers can't see this product yet:
preview.reasonRemoved: it was removed by an administrator.
preview.isPublic: This product is live on the marketplace.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: Where you deliver, how, and whether buyers can collect from your farm.
delivery.changeInProfile: Change it in your farm profile
delivery.pickupLabel: Buyers can collect orders from my farm
delivery.feeHint: Leave empty if it's free or agreed per order.
delivery.notesHint: For example delivery days or cut-off times.
delivery.duplicate: You already have this delivery area.

enquiries.title: Enquiries
enquiries.intro: Requests from buyers about your products.
enquiries.emptyBody: Enquiries from buyers will appear here.
enquiries.noContact: The buyer didn't share a phone number.

enquiries.updateFailed: Couldn't update the enquiry. Please try again.

profile.title: Farm profile
profile.intro: What buyers see about you and your farm.
profile.welcome: Welcome! Complete your farm profile so buyers can find and trust you.
profile.locationFailed: Couldn't get your location. You can enter the coordinates instead.
profile.mapInvalid: Enter a location in the Maldives (latitude −1 to 8, longitude 72 to 74.5).
profile.logoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
profile.locationNote: Changing your farm location also updates the location shown on your products.

enquiry.title: Send an enquiry
enquiry.intro: Ask the farmer about this product. They'll see your enquiry in their portal.
enquiry.messageHint: For example when you need it, or questions about the product.
enquiry.shareContact: Share my name and phone number with the farmer so they can contact me
enquiry.name: Your name
enquiry.sent: Enquiry sent. The farmer can see it now — you'll find its status under My enquiries.
enquiry.signIn: Sign in to send an enquiry
enquiry.failed: Couldn't send the enquiry. Please try again.
enquiry.notAvailable: This product is sold out, so enquiries are closed.

report.intro: Reports are private. An administrator reviews every report.
report.detailsHint: At least 10 characters. Include dates, amounts or messages if you can.
report.sent: Report received. You can follow its status under My reports.
report.failed: Couldn't send the report. Please try again.
report.privacy: The person you report won't see your name, your contact details or what you wrote.
report.evidenceHint: Up to 3 photos or PDFs, 5 MB each. Only administrators can see them.
report.evidenceTooMany: You can attach up to 3 files.
report.evidenceBad: {name} must be a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF of 5 MB or less.

errors.duplicate: You've already reported this and it's still being reviewed. You can follow it under My reports.
errors.rate_limited: You've sent several reports recently. Please try again tomorrow, or contact us if it's urgent.
errors.restricted: Sending reports is turned off for your account.
errors.evidence_invalid: One of the files couldn't be accepted. Remove it and try again.

farmersPending.help: Farmer registrations not yet approved or rejected.

productsPending.help: New listings waiting for approval (only while pre-approval is on).

paymentsVerified.help: Part of the recorded total that an administrator has verified.

users.searchLabel: Name, email, phone or account id
users.name: Name

userDetail.adminAccount: This is an administrator account. Administrators are managed with the admin script, not from this page.

userActions.title: Actions
userActions.approveConfirm: Approve this farm? It and its published listings will appear on the marketplace.
userActions.rejectConfirm: Reject this farm registration? Its listings stay hidden.
userActions.suspendConfirm: Suspend this account? They're signed out, can't make changes, and a farmer's listings are hidden until the suspension ends.
userActions.blockConfirm: Block this account indefinitely? They can't sign in, and a farmer's listings are hidden, until an owner restores the account.
userActions.restoreConfirm: Restore this account? They can sign in again and a farmer's farm becomes visible again (if approved).
userActions.restrictHelp: Ticked features are switched off for this account. Untick all to remove restrictions.
userActions.roleConfirm: Switch this account to {role}? Their current sessions end.

productDetail.approveConfirm: Approve this listing? It goes live if the farmer has published it and the farm is approved.
productDetail.rejectConfirm: Reject this listing? The farmer sees your reason and can edit and resubmit it.
productDetail.removeConfirm: Remove this listing? It's hidden and locked; the farmer sees your reason and can't edit or delete it.
productDetail.restoreConfirm: Restore this listing? It goes live again if published.
productDetail.deactivateConfirm: Mark this listing inactive (paused)? The farmer can publish it again; use Remove to keep it down.
productDetail.featureHint: Only live listings can be featured.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Reports from buyers and farmers. Reporters see the status and your outcome note.
reports.subject: Reported account
reports.requestInfo: Ask the reporter for more information
reports.requestInfoBody: The reporter sees this question in My reports. The report waits for their reply.
reports.notesHint: Only administrators can see these notes — never the reporter or the reported person.
reports.decisionBody: Choose what happens. Account actions are applied to the reported account and recorded in its enforcement history.
reports.userReason: Reason shown to the reported account
reports.userReasonHint: Don't mention who reported them or what the reporter wrote.

reference.title: Locations & categories
reference.intro: Reference data used across the marketplace.
reference.idsFixed: Category and unit ids are fixed in the code, because listings, filters and security rules depend on them. You can change their names and whether farmers can choose them for new listings. Existing listings keep their category and unit.
reference.atollsFixed: The 21 atoll codes and names follow the official administrative divisions and can't be changed here.
reference.islandsIntro: Islands people choose for farm and delivery locations. An island's id never changes, because farms, listings and enquiries point to it. Islands in use can't be deleted or moved to another atoll — deactivate them instead.
reference.deleteConfirm: Delete this island? Only possible when nothing uses it.
reference.noIslands: No islands yet. Import the official list with the islands:import script (see docs/firebase-setup.md), or add one here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Platform moderation settings and admin access.
settings.approvalHelp: When on, new listings stay hidden until an administrator approves them. Listings that are already live aren't affected.
settings.approvalOff: Off — new listings go live when published
settings.approvalConfirmOn: Turn on pre-approval? New listings will wait for review before going live.
settings.approvalConfirmOff: Turn off pre-approval? New listings will go live as soon as farmers publish them. Listings already waiting stay in the review queue.
settings.accessHelp: Administrators can only be added, removed or changed with the admin command-line script, which needs Firebase project credentials. Nobody can raise their own access from this website.

permissions.admin_view: View the dashboard, accounts, listings and reports
permissions.products_moderate: Approve, reject, remove and pause listings

settings.appealsHelp: Whether users can appeal warnings, restrictions, suspensions and blocks from their account notices.
settings.appealsConfirmOn: Open appeals? Users can appeal enforcement actions again.
settings.appealsConfirmOff: Close appeals? Users can't submit new appeals until you open them again. Pending appeals stay in the queue.
settings.holdHelp: When allowed, an administrator can pause the appeal on a specific action while an investigation is under way, with a justification the user can see.
settings.holdConfirmOn: Allow administrators to pause appeals during investigations?
settings.holdConfirmOff: Stop allowing paused appeals? Actions already paused stay paused until decided.

logs.title: Audit log
logs.intro: Every significant administrative action, newest first. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

enforcement.title: Enforcement history
enforcement.warnBody: The user sees the warning and its reason in their account notices. Nothing else changes.
enforcement.holdAppeal: Pause appeals while this is investigated
enforcement.holdReason: Why appeals are paused (shown to the user)

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.intro: Appeals waiting for a decision. Overturning lifts the action; upholding keeps it.
appeals.upholdBody: Keep the decision. The user sees your note.
appeals.overturnBody: Lift the action (restore the account or remove the restriction). The user sees your note.
appeals.overturned: Appeal overturned and the action lifted.

records.createBody: Open an internal report about this account (for things you noticed yourself). It goes into the reports queue.

accountReports.awaitingHint: We need more information from you before we can continue.
accountReports.replyFailed: Couldn't send your reply. Please try again.

notices.title: Account notices
notices.intro: Warnings and restrictions on your account, and your appeals.
notices.emptyBody: Your account is in good standing.
notices.banner: There's a notice about your account.
notices.appealIntro: If you think this was a mistake, explain why. An administrator will review your appeal and reply here.
notices.appealSent: Appeal sent. You'll see the outcome here.
notices.appealUpheld: Your appeal was reviewed and the decision stands.
notices.appealOverturned: Your appeal was accepted and the action was lifted.
notices.appealHeld: Appeals on this decision are paused while an investigation is under way. Reason: {reason}
notices.appealsDisabled: Appeals aren't open at the moment. Contact us if you need help.
notices.appealFailed: Couldn't send your appeal. Please try again.

appealErrors.not_appealable: This decision can no longer be appealed.
appealErrors.appeal_held: Appeals on this decision are paused while an investigation is under way.
appealErrors.appeals_disabled: Appeals aren't open at the moment.

appealPage.title: Your account
appealPage.intro: Your account can't be used at the moment. Here's why, and how to appeal.
appealPage.signIn: Sign in to see your account notices and appeal.
appealPage.failed: Couldn't load your notices. Please try again.
